# Identifier sweep: shapes that must never appear in a tracked file.
# Read by .github/workflows/scan.yml (every tracked file, on push / PR) and
# .githooks/pre-commit (the lines a commit adds). These are identifiers,
# not credentials, so gitleaks' rules miss most of them.
#
# One entry per line: `pattern <ERE>` or `exclude <path>`. Extend when a
# review finds a new shape; keep each pattern a plain ERE. Synthetic
# fixtures use the real domains on purpose (role-from-domain is product
# logic), so the student rule matches only digit-only local parts — the
# shape a real student account has — and there is no staff-address rule:
# a named address has no fixed shape, review catches those.

pattern arn:aws:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:
pattern \b[0-9]{12}\b.*(aws://|--profile)
pattern [0-9]{10,}-[a-z0-9]+\.apps\.googleusercontent\.com
pattern \b[0-9]{4,10}@edtools\.psd401\.net
pattern securetest\.psd401\.ai
pattern \b168\.212\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\b
pattern docs/requests/

# Files that carry the patterns themselves, or document them.
exclude .github/identifier-sweep.txt
exclude .github/workflows/scan.yml
exclude .gitleaks.toml
exclude .githooks/pre-commit
exclude docs/public-release-plan.md
exclude design-tool/infra/cdk.context.json.example
